def factor_range_pressure_downvol_sq(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    # Primary: cycle range pressure over 60 days (from market_cycle_0002)
    buy_pressure = (close - df_copy["low"]).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    sell_pressure = (df_copy["high"] - close).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    total_range = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    range_pressure = (buy_pressure - sell_pressure) / total_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    # Lightweight modifier: downside volume participation (from parent1), squared to preserve signal in normal regimes
    ret = close.pct_change()
    down_vol = volume.where(ret < 0, 0.0).rolling(60, min_periods=30).sum()
    total_vol = volume.rolling(60, min_periods=30).sum().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    down_ratio = down_vol / total_vol
    attenuation = 1.0 - down_ratio ** 2
    factor = range_pressure * attenuation
    df_copy["factor_range_pressure_downvol_sq"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_range_pressure_downvol_sq"]
description: Preserves the primary cycle range-pressure mechanism from market_cycle_0002, which identifies accumulation/distribution phase by the position of closes within the trailing 60-day high-low range. Borrows the lightweight downside-volume-participation concept from g1_crossover_market_cycle_0002_acp_gen0_b_tail_skew_volume_as_7ac47edd but applies a squared attenuation (1 - down_ratio^2) instead of linear (1 - down_ratio). This preserves more raw range-pressure signal when downside volume participation is moderate (near 0.5), reducing over-attenuation in normal volume regimes, while still strongly dampening when downside volume dominates. Targets improved IC and ICIR while retaining RankIC and MI from the parent crossover. Cross-sectional transform remains none to preserve raw payoff structure.
